summary: IndexMap::truncate clears index slots of removed entries without repairing probe chains, so keys still in the map cannot be found.
IndexMap accepts any power-of-two N although Pos holds a 16-bit index, so maps above 65536 entries overflow in Pos::new, lose keys, and can hang in remove.
spsc len() computes (tail - head + N) % N with a wrapping add, which wraps when N is close to usize::MAX, so it undercounts and iter() yields too few items.
spsc iterators compute head + index unchecked, which overflows and panics in debug when N exceeds usize::MAX/2 and head is high.
